## Kit audit (what already exists and what does not fit)

- `kits/heart-circulation` (HeartKit v2): reused for L01 zoom, L02 bench and zoom, L03, L04, L05, L06 and the hub. Read its source: `heart(opts)` exposes `ra, rv, la, lv, septum, lvWall, rvWall, tricuspid, bicuspid, aorticValve, pulmValve, aorta, pulmonaryArtery, pulmonaryVeins, venaCava, coronary, san, avn, his, purkinje, chordae, papillary` and modes `both | pace | sys | exterior | dissect | specimen`; `userData.beat = { aSys, vSys, avOpen, slOpen }` and `setState({ bpm, mode, hold })` are enough to sync a pulse bench. It has **no** RA / LA wall anchors, no scalpel or ruler, no chordae-cut state in `valve`, no `focus` in `vessels` (the header promises it; `setState` is empty), no citrate state in `bloodSmear`, and no antibody / clumping view.
- `kits/agar-cube-bench` (v1, `AgarCubeKit`, from ss1): a dye-front model for L = 1–6 mm (`L_mm` is clamped to 1–6), pink **dye shell** with an undyed core. Lesson 01 needs the reverse chemistry (alkali + phenolphthalein agar goes **pink → colourless** where acid has entered, so the **core stays pink**), four cubes of 5–30 mm in one beaker, acid depth 3.0 mm, % colourless readings. So it is a base to upgrade (v2, backward compatible), not a drop-in. `HeartKit.cube` is a single cube with a fixed 0.5 mm reach and does not fit either.
- `kits/microscope-bench` (no README; `window.MicroscopeBench.create(opts)` eyepiece-disc code): its field-of-view disc technique can be copied for `vessel-slide-bench` and `blood-count-bench` (specimen drawn on a `CanvasTexture`), but its slides are cork / onion / blood only.
- `kits/osmometer-bench`, `kits/slide-prep-bench`, `kits/protein-route`: ss1 practicals, not relevant here.
- `kits/video/{heart, capillary-bed, blood, sa-volume-cubes}` and the `graph` video kit already cover the three explainer videos (lessons 04, 05, 06); no kit-engineer work for step 5v is requested here.

## New kits (for kit-engineer, step 6) — HeartKit v2 fidelity (`.agents/skills/kit-builder/SKILL.md`)

Each kit lives in `kits/<id>/` with `README.md` + `demo.html`, a classic script exposing `window.<Name>`, `group.userData.parts` (names as in the table above), `update(dt, t)`, `setState()`, `reading()` computed from a model (never pasted numbers), highlight support via `HeartKit.makeHighlighter`, and must run offline with `window.THREE` + `window.SceneKit`. Use `THREE.Shape` + `ExtrudeGeometry` for solid cut-aways, `CatmullRomCurve3` + `TubeGeometry` for vessels and leads, `LatheGeometry` for glassware and cells, procedural `CanvasTexture` + bump maps, per-vertex colour for oxygen gradients. **No primitive soup**: pass the Unlabeled Recognition Test.

1. **`agar-cube-bench` v2 (upgrade, same API, bump to version 2)** — L01 bench. New option `mode: "acid"`: alkali agar made with phenolphthalein, **pink** where acid has not reached, **colourless** where it has. Params: `sides` (default `[5, 10, 20, 30]` mm, all four cubes shown together in one beaker; `L_mm` clamp lifted to 1–30 in acid mode), `acidDepth_mm` (default 3.0, the depth on every face after 8 min), `t_min` (default 8). Model: `depth = min(acidDepth, L / 2)`, pink core side = `L − 2·depth`, pink volume = core³, `% colourless = (V − core³) / V × 100`. `reading()` → `{ L_mm, SA, V, ratio, depth_mm, core_mm, pinkVolume, pctColourless }`; expected 5 → 100 %, 10 → 93.6 %, 20 → 65.7 %, 30 → 48.8 % (pink volumes 0, 64, 2744, 13 824 mm³). Props: dilute-acid beaker (`LatheGeometry`, glass, meniscus, hydrochloric acid label), stainless forceps (extruded jaws, pivot), white tile with grid lines, scalpel blade, mm ruler on a `CanvasTexture`; cubes are translucent with a bevelled edge and a cut-away octant (extruded `Shape`) showing the pink core and the colourless rim; a clock face counts to 8 min. Optional `errors: { lateLift, flatOnFloor, oversizedCube }` shift % colourless in the documented directions (02 § L01 sources of error). Parts: `cube, beaker, acid, forceps, ruler, tile, blade`. Backward compatible with the ss1 L03 calls (`L_mm`, `t_min`, `dyeDepth_mm`, `cutaway`, `labels`, `emit`, `AgarCubeKit.model`).
2. **`dissection-bench`** — L02 bench, wraps `HeartKit.heart`. Dissecting board (rounded extruded slab with grain texture, pinned corners), fresh goat heart (use `heart({ mode: "specimen" })` colours: fat, pericardium, rubbery aorta and thinner pulmonary artery, groove on the front), stainless scalpel (`LatheGeometry` handle with grip bump, extruded blade, blade facing away flag), 30 cm ruler (graduated `CanvasTexture`, read at eye level), gloves optional. **Cut reveal:** a clipping-plane sweep from apex upwards switches the specimen to `dissect` (longitudinal section with cavity holes) while the scalpel follows the cut line. Add **RA and LA wall anchors** (thin, 1.5 mm and 2.0 mm) beside the existing `rvWall`, `lvWall`, `septum`. `measure(part)` returns the simulated readings of 02 § L02 (RA 1.6 / 1.4, LA 2.1 / 1.9, RV 4.2 / 3.8, LV 12.4 / 11.6, septum 10.8 / 11.2 mm) with a callout arrow, and `reading()` returns `{ region, r1, r2, mean, pumpsTo, ratioLVRV }` (LV : RV = 3.0). Optional `errors: { slantCut, papillaryIncluded, shrunken }`. Parts as the L02 list.
3. **`body-circuit`** — L03 bench and zoom. Translucent standing body (extruded outline `Shape` with torso cavity), organs as recognisable shapes (lathe/extruded lungs with bronchi, lobed liver, coiled gut tube, bean kidneys, brain with gyri, arm and leg), vessels as `CatmullRomCurve3` tubes with per-vertex red→purple→blue colour, named parts (`carotid, jugular, subclavianA/V, renalA/V, femoralA/V, hepaticPortal, hepaticVein, coronary`). **Route tracer:** `trace(path)` moves a red-blue particle along the vessels with `HeartKit.heart` (`both`) beside it; the particle turns red only in the lungs; `reading()` → `{ route, valves, passedLungs }`; presets arm → brain, ileum → brain, liver → kidney, lungs → heart muscle. `view: "portal"`: gut capillary mesh → hepatic portal vein → liver sinusoids (glucose spheres becoming glycogen granules) → hepatic vein. `view: "coronary"`: aorta root with valve, two coronary arteries over the heart surface, **`blocked`** toggle greys the muscle beyond the blockage.
4. **`pulse-bench`** — L04 bench. Forearm and hand (lathe/spline sculpt), radial artery under the wrist that visibly bulges at the live rate (driven by the heart's `phase`), index and middle fingers, stopwatch (face texture, ticking hand), step stool, sphygmomanometer cuff with a mercury column that rises to 120 and falls to 80 mmHg (readout in HTML as well). Model: rest 68 bpm; after 2 min of step-ups 132 bpm; recovery `bpm(t)` follows the monotone curve through 132, 116, 96, 80, 72, 68 at 0–5 min (so the table and the graph reproduce 02 § L04); a 15 s count = `round(bpm × 15 / 60)` with ±1 beat noise on repeats. `reading()` → `{ t_min, count15, bpm, cycle_s, resting }`. Drives `HeartKit.heart` with `setState({ bpm })`. Parts: `wrist, radialArtery, fingers, stopwatch, step, heart, san, avn, his, purkinje`.
5. **`vessel-slide-bench`** — L05 station 1. Eyepiece-disc view (`CanvasTexture`, 2D-in-3D, reuse the `microscope-bench` disc technique) of a prepared artery + vein cross-section pair at low power: elastic laminae wavy and stained, thick muscular `tunicaMedia`, collapsed wide vein lumen, thin adventitia, a capillary profile one flat cell wide beside a red cell. Eyepiece graticule with a stage-micrometre calibration step (toggle *Calibrate*; skipping it makes every measurement off by the same factor). `reading()` returns wall and lumen in mm from the model (artery 0.90 / 2.2, vein 0.40 / 4.0). Optional `errors: { slant, collapsedVein, noCalibration }`. Includes the 3D `HeartKit.vessels` pair on the bench as the "real vessel" reference. Also implement `HeartKit.vessels` `setState({ focus })` (promised in its header, currently a no-op) so a part can be spotlighted.
6. **`blood-count-bench`** — L06 bench. Stained smear field at ×100 and ×400 (`CanvasTexture` disc, red cells with pale centres, lobed phagocyte, round-nucleus lymphocyte, platelets) driven by `HeartKit.bloodSmear` for the 3D reference; improved Neubauer-style **haemocytometer** (thick glass slide with two ruled chambers as an extruded `Shape`, coverslip, ruled grid on a `CanvasTexture`, 5 medium squares each 0.2 × 0.2 mm, depth 0.1 mm), pipette with 1 in 200 dilution. `nextSquare()` returns per-square counts 98, 92, 101, 95, 94 (seeded, sum 480); `reading()` → `{ squares, total, volume_mm3: total_squares × 0.004, diluted, undiluted }` (24 000 mm⁻³ diluted, 4.8 × 10⁶ mm⁻³ undiluted). Optional `sickle` toggle (preview for L07). Parts as L06 list.
7. **`abo-typing-bench`** — L07 bench and zoom. White ceramic tile with three wells per sample (extruded dimples), anti-A (blue), anti-B (yellow) and anti-D (clear) dropper bottles (`LatheGeometry` glass with rubber teat), fresh stirrers, lancet and sharps bin. **Agglutination is computed:** `clump = donorAntigen ∧ serumAntibody` for each well; clumped wells show granular red specks against clear fluid, unclumped wells stay smooth. Samples (02 § L07 expected table): `rider` (B, Rh−), `donor1` (O, Rh−, safe), `donor2` (A, Rh−), `donor3` (B, Rh+), `donor4` (AB, Rh−); reaction pattern anti-A / anti-B / anti-D: rider − + −, donor 1 − − −, donor 2 + − −, donor 3 − + +, donor 4 + + −. `reading()` → `{ sample, A, B, D, group }`. `view: "agglutination"`: Y-shaped antibodies (extruded Y `Shape`) bridging group B cells in anti-B serum until they clump, beside free cells in a compatible mix. `view: "rhesus"`: staged animation of an Rh− mother and an Rh+ baby over two pregnancies (sensitisation, then anti-D crossing the placenta; anti-D injection prevents it). Parts as L07 list.
8. **HeartKit v2.1 additions (backward compatible, in `kits/heart-circulation/`)** — `valve.setState({ chordaeCut: true })` (flaps evert into the atrium and a leak jet appears when the ventricle squeezes, per 02 § L02 zoom); `bloodSmear.setState({ citrate: true })` (calcium removed: fibrin threads fail to form while platelets still gather, per 02 § L06 zoom); `vessels.setState({ focus })` as above. After shipping, update the README and the version, and unit-renderer re-copies `heart-kit.js` into `html/assets/js/` in Phase B.

## Shared conventions (every lesson-builder must follow)

**Files per lesson:** `index.html`, `data.js`, `story.js`, `bench.js`, `zoom.js`, `lesson.js`, `narration.js`, plus `graph.js` for lessons 01, 04 and 05. Never edit `html/index.html` or `html/assets/**`.

**Script order** in `lessons/lesson-0X/index.html`:
`../../assets/js/three.min.js` → `scene-kit.js` → `heart-kit.js` → (new kit scripts, once kit-engineer ships them and the director has had unit-renderer copy them into `html/assets/js/`: `agar-cube-bench.js` (v2) for L01, then one file per new kit for its lesson) → `retrieval-bank.js` → `data.js` → `lesson-kit.js` → `story-scene.js` → `story.js` → `bench.js` → (`study-graph.js` → `graph.js`) → `zoom.js` → `lesson.js` → `narration.js` → `narrator.js` → `math-kit.js`.
Until a new kit ships, build the bench from `HeartKit` plus clearly marked fallback code inside `bench.js` behind a `window.<Kit>` check, so the page never throws; the real kit replaces it later without changing the part names.
**CSS links:** `fonts.css`, `style.css`, `lesson.css`, `narrator.css`, `math.css`, then `theme.css` last (apply-theme re-links it). Do **not** link `hub.css`.

**Body:** `<body class="lesson-page" data-lesson="l0X">` (`l01` … `l07`, matches the `RETRIEVAL_BANK` keys).

**Section ids (the retrieval bank's revisit links point at these — keep them exactly):**
`#donow` (with `#donow-list`), `#story` (`#story-stage`, `#story-text`), `#wonder`, `#sort`, `#practical` (`#method-cards` with `#m1`–`#m4` (L05: `#m1`–`#m4` for each station, 3–4 numbered cards per station), `#bench-stage`, `#bench-canvas`, `#bench-readout`, `#results-table`, `#expected`), `#concepts` (`#props-table`, `#pos-explorer`), `#zoom` (`#zoom-stage`, `#zoom-canvas`), `#examples` (`#ex1`–`#ex4`, `ol.steps-sol` for StudyMath), `#bridge` (`#big-idea`), `#quiz` (`#quiz-list`), `#reflect` (`#rate-list`), `#assignment`. Lessons 01, 04 and 05: `#graph-card` with `.graph-card` under the bench. The retrieval bank's `sec` values in use: `concepts`, `props-table`, `examples`.

**Phase 5 rating:** every lesson's `#reflect` has the **"I can (1–4)" self-rating list** (the `I can` items in 02 § 5, one per row, scale 1–4) via LessonKit's `#rate-list`; Reflect also holds the exit ticket and the blank-page recall (`RETRIEVAL_BANK[lXX].recall`). **Each bench has 3–4 numbered method cards** (L05: per station) — round-2 review rule.

**Make Sense for explainer videos (lessons 04, 05, 06 — `apply-video.mjs` finds it):** the `#concepts` section must keep `<span class="phase" …><b>3</b>Make sense · …</span>` **and** an `<h2>` directly in that section. Do not rename the label, and keep `StudyNarrator.pause()` untouched. Do this in **all seven** lessons for consistency, in case the cap is raised later.

**CustomEvents** (`document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(name, { detail }))`):
- `l0X:bench` (each trial/measurement, detail = the computed `reading()`), `l0X:bench-done` (completion rule in the table above), `l0X:bench-reset`.
- `l0X:zoom` (mode change, `{ mode }`), `l0X:bridge` (bridge answered, `{ correct }`).
- LessonKit already emits `kit:donow`, `kit:note`, `kit:quiz-done`, `kit:rated`, `kit:solution` (the narrator has a built-in `donow` wait only). The sort game is lesson code: `lesson.js` must emit `l0X:sort` (`{ correct, total }`) on *Check*, and each `narration.js` defines its own `waits` for `note`, `sort`, `bench`, `bridge`, `pin` (explorer) and `quiz` on these events. The hub's own events are `lab:result`, `hub:tab`, `hub:flip` (hub only).

**3D scene API** (`window.StudyScenes.bench` / `.zoom`): `rect(part)`, `highlight(part)`, `setMode(mode)`, `reset()`, plus lesson actions called by narration as `"bench:<method>:<arg>"`. Part names exactly as in the table above. Bench stages use `SceneKit.createStage` with default auto-framing; story stages pass `autoFit: false, zoomUi: false, portraitPitch: 0`. A beating `HeartKit.heart` is advanced by calling `heart.userData.update(dt, t)` every frame; the heart faces the viewer, so the patient's right side is on screen left (say so in every label and narration line).

**Phone rules:** live values in an HTML `.bench-readout` under the canvas (hide floating 3D HUD sprites below 560 px); 3D labels ≤ ~20 characters (HeartKit's own labels are sprites: pass `labels: false` on small story props and use the HTML readout); never `text-transform: uppercase` on anything with units or symbols (mmHg, mm⁻¹, cm³ s⁻¹, Pc, πc, SA : V, bpm).

**CSS class names to reuse:** `.l-sec`, `.phase` (`--pc` token colour), `.stage`, `.bench-readout`, `.graph-card`, `.tbl`, `.eq`, `.callout`, `.callout.big`, `.example`, `ol.steps-sol`, `.answer-line`, `.aq`, `.solution .reveal-body`, `.sort`, `.quiz`, `.donow`. Lesson-specific CSS goes in a `<style>` block in the lesson page using tokens only (`var(--paper-card)`, `rgba(var(--ok-rgb), .1)`, `var(--font-mono)`), never literal colours or font names.

**Data:** `window.LESSON_QUIZ` in `data.js` = the 12 MCQs from `03-questions.md` § Lesson 0X, `{ q, o: [4], a: index, e }`, keys unchanged (A/B/C/D spread as reviewed). LessonKit appends the bank's 2 review MCQs after them (l02 onward).

**Narration:** `window.NARRATION` per lesson, 26–30 steps (02 § 6), Nigerian English (`en-NG` ranked first), symbols spelled out in `say` ("millimetres of mercury", "beats per minute", "sixty divided by seventy-two", "S A N" and "A V N" letter by letter, "lub" and "dub" as words, "pi c"/"P c" spoken as "the pull of the plasma proteins" and "blood pressure P c"). Spotlight cues worth scripting: L02 `lv` vs `rv` thickness; L04 `san → avn → his → purkinje` with LUB and DUB captions; L05 `probe` stops at 0 and 1 with NFP arrows; L06 `fibrin` weave; L07 anti-B well clumping.

**Facts to keep consistent with the hub:** LV wall about 3 × the RV wall (goat-heart readings 12.0 mm vs 4.0 mm, ratio 3.0); heart cycle 60 ÷ bpm (72 bpm → 0.83 s; one cycle ≈ 0.8 s at 75 bpm: 0.4 s relaxed, 0.1 s atria, 0.3 s ventricles); Chidi 68 → 132 → 68 bpm, recovery curve 132, 116, 96, 80, 72, 68; cardiac output 68 × 70 = 4760 cm³ min⁻¹ = 4.76 dm³ min⁻¹; capillary Pc 36 → 16 mmHg with πc = 25 mmHg (NFP +11 at the arterial end, −9 at the venous end, zero 55% of the way along); aorta 2.4 cm² × 35 cm s⁻¹ = 84 cm³ s⁻¹, capillaries 2400 cm², v = 0.035 cm s⁻¹; red cell count 480 cells ÷ 0.020 mm³ × 200 = 4.8 × 10⁶ mm⁻³; blood 55% plasma / 45% cells; "O gives, AB receives"; the rider is group B, Rh−, and the cool box holds O+, O−, A−, B+, B−, AB− (two safe first choices: O− and B−).
